attempts.summary: Published node4's port-8080 HTTP service on node2's transit address (10.10.2.2) port 80, and configured routing on node1 and node3 so node3 (on lan-a) reaches the service by asking node2 rather than addressing node4 directly. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, each confirmed via changed boot identity, with full service/route recovery verified after each restart.
